reason: The harness-rendered contract block invalidates the plan approval it promises not to affect. strip_derived_sections substitutes a newline for a block that was appended after one, so the stripped body carries one more trailing newline than the file had before the block existed, and plan_body_digest hashes that difference. task approve then refuses with 'the plan CHANGED after <name> approved it' when the authored text is byte-identical. Normalise the approved body's trailing newlines before hashing.
